items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: he was a serious erudite kind of guy, Charlie was, and he was funny, he was serious but he was funny; but Charlie never really hung.

ctx.x: But Charlie was, you know, really partying pretty much all the time. And he was a serious erudite kind of guy, Charlie was, and he was funny, he was serious but he was funny; but Charlie never really hung. He wasn’t a hanger like we were hanging, we were like still kids, really. Gil was the only elder statesman…
